shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; node --version; npm --version

(PORT=3123 node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && cat /tmp/server.log
echo "--- add book"
curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3123/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Chapter 3 so far" | grep -i '^location'
ID=$(curl -s -i -X POST localhost:3123/books --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke" | grep -i '^location' | sed 's/.*\/books\///' | tr -d '\r')
echo "second id: $ID"
echo "--- finish second from home"
curl -s -i -X POST "localhost:3123/books/$ID/finish?back=home" | grep -i '^location'
echo "--- home page lists"
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -E 'class="title"|finished|Mark finished' 
echo "--- book page"
curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID | grep -E '<h1>|by |Share|badge'
echo "--- JSON on disk"
cat data/books.json
echo "--- restart"
pkill -f "node server.mjs"; sleep 0.5
(PORT=3123 node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -c 'class="title"'
pkill -f "node server.mjs"

pgrep -f "server.mjs" | xargs -r kill; sleep 0.3
PORT=3123 node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1
echo "books listed after restart: $(curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -c 'class="title"')"
kill $SERVER_PID
rm -rf data
ls data 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/server.log; pgrep -fa server.mjs || echo "no server running"

sleep 1; echo "books listed after restart: $(curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -c 'class="title"')"; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -A1 'class="title"' | grep -oE '>[^<]+|finished [A-Za-z0-9, ]+|Mark finished'
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -4 && git status --short
